protected_outcomes_from_supplied_syllabu.CLO 1: Safely operate Torchmate 4X00 CNC plasma equipment following Torchmate Academy standards.
protected_outcomes_from_supplied_syllabu.CLO 2: Configure FlexCut 80 consumables and settings for various materials and thicknesses.
protected_outcomes_from_supplied_syllabu.CLO 3: Use VMD SP2 to perform startup, shutdown, alignment, AVHC adjustments, nesting, and first-cut procedures.
protected_outcomes_from_supplied_syllabu.CLO 4: Create and modify CAD files using Torchmate CAD including shapes, paths, offsets, nesting, and GM-file output.
protected_outcomes_from_supplied_syllabu.CLO 5: Diagnose and correct cut-quality issues such as bevel, dross, kerf variation, and torch misfires.
protected_outcomes_from_supplied_syllabu.CLO 6: Perform daily, monthly, and as-needed maintenance procedures based on Torchmate Academy modules.
protected_outcomes_from_supplied_syllabu.CLO 7: Produce a CNC-cut project demonstrating dimensional accuracy and proper toolpath preparation.
